_meta.purpose: Example shape for support_trends.area_map and support_trends.routing_rules. Copy into your config and replace the placeholders with your own product areas. Not authoritative: the skill adds confirmed aliases over time.
_meta.how_matching_works: A ticket matches an area when its tags match the area's tags or tag_prefixes, or its subject and human-authored comment match the area's names, aliases, or feature names. Tag plus text agreement = strong; one clear match = moderate; loose text only = weak.
